author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m installing Oatey’s freestanding tub drain with PVC. It’s critical to make that subfloor hole 4 inches in diameter and the P-Trap level. This helps the drain body be installed properly. The tailpiece connects to the tub and slides down into the drain body. This kit is available in different options and is great for freestanding tubs. Many thanks to Oatey for sending the kit for my client’s bathroom renovation
title: Oatey Freestanding Tub Drain Installation Tips - #shorts #plumbing #bathroomrenovation
